theme.name: Rollout timetable and local publication
theme.claim: Forces have prepared the new data collection system for 1 April 2017 and will publish information locally each quarter, with an annual snapshot of key data going to the Home Office through the Annual Data Requirement for 2017/18.

text.line: Work has been undertaken by police forces to implement the new data collection system recommended by the review by 1 April 2017.

Forces will publish the information locally on a quarterly basis, and provide an annual snap-shot of the key information collected to the Home Office as part of the Annual Data Requirement for 2017/18.
